page.overview:
What is Paldea?

Paldea is a region that was introduced in Generation IX. It is where takes place and is seemingly based off the real-world . Its name was revealed on August 3, 2022.

A small town on a cape in the south of the Paldea region. It is the hometown of the player and their rival, Nemona.

A focal point of the region, the institute is said to have a history that exceeds other schools. The campus the player attends will depend on the version they play. They are run by the director Clavell.

A town that's famous for its flowers and art. It has a windmill, small houses, and fresh greenery everywhere. Appropriately enough, Brassius is the Gym Leader here. He specializes in Pokémon and is known as the 'Verdant Virtuoso'.
